title: CartridgeFlow 协议知识库
description: 本地只读浏览器：同时查看权威协议原本与产品治理快照。

protocol-source.title: 权威协议原本
protocol-source.description: 来自独立协议仓库的权威 SQLite 副本，只包含 current 与 temp-runtime 两条协议线。

data_contract_catalog.title: 数据合同目录
data_contract_catalog.description: 按四层、领域、合同族和版本查看显式登记的数据合同。
data_contract_catalog.sql: select layer as '层', domain as '领域', display_name as '合同', contract_id as '合同 ID', version as '合同版本', lifecycle as '状态', owner as '负责方', purpose as '用途', owner_protocol_id as '定义协议', owner_protocol_version as '协议版本', definition_path as '定义位置', rule_count as '规则数' from data_contract_overview order by layer, domain_order, domain, sort_order, contract_id, version

protocol_catalog.title: 协议目录
protocol_catalog.description: 浏览协议发布记录；协议线留空时同时展示 current 与 temp-runtime。
protocol_catalog.sql: select source_id as '协议线', protocol_id as '协议 ID', version as '版本', name as '名称', category as '类别', lifecycle as '生命周期', specification_status as '规范状态', implementation_status as '实现状态', runtime_adapter as '运行时适配器', artifact_count as '文件数' from protocol_release_overview where (:source_id = '' or source_id = :source_id) order by source_id, protocol_id, version

read_protocol.title: 阅读协议
read_protocol.description: 输入协议 ID，例如 CF-FARP；协议线、版本和文件路径可留空。
read_protocol.sql: select source_id as '协议线', protocol_id as '协议 ID', version as '版本', artifact_path as '文件', content as '正文' from protocol_document where protocol_id = :protocol_id and (:source_id = '' or source_id = :source_id) and (:version = '' or version = :version) and (:artifact_path = '' or artifact_path = :artifact_path) order by source_id, version, artifact_path

search_protocols.title: 搜索协议章节
search_protocols.description: 搜索标题与 Markdown 章节内容；协议线留空时搜索两条线。
search_protocols.sql: select section.source_id as '协议线', release.protocol_id as '协议 ID', release.version as '版本', section.artifact_path as '文件', section.heading as '章节', section.line_start as '起始行', section.line_end as '结束行', section.content as '正文' from section_fts as section left join protocol_release as release on release.release_key = section.release_key where :query != '' and (:source_id = '' or section.source_id = :source_id) and (instr(lower(section.heading), lower(:query)) > 0 or instr(lower(section.content), lower(:query)) > 0) order by section.source_id, release.protocol_id, release.version, section.artifact_path, section.line_start limit 200

source_overview.description: Responsibility boundary and aggregate counts for each protocol line.

protocol_release_overview.description: Queryable release catalog for both protocol lines.

protocol_document.description: Complete protocol artifacts projected as readable text.

protocol_outline.description: Heading-level document navigation with source line numbers.

protocol-registry.title: 产品治理快照
protocol-registry.description: 产品实际消费的只读快照：权威协议副本、Base 实现证据和经过白名单批准的源码配置。

configuration_catalog.title: 配置目录
configuration_catalog.description: 查看纳入产品治理快照的固定 config 白名单。运行态 .data 永不入库。
configuration_catalog.sql: select artifact_path as '文件', artifact_kind as '类型', media_type as '媒体类型', byte_size as '字节数', content_digest as 'SHA-256' from artifact where source_id = 'current' and artifact_path like 'config/%' order by artifact_path

read_configuration.title: 阅读配置
read_configuration.description: 输入配置文件路径；JSON 会以代码块显示。
read_configuration.sql: select artifact_path as '文件', artifact_kind as '类型', case when media_type like 'application/json%' then '```json' || char(10) || text_content || char(10) || '```' else text_content end as '内容' from artifact where source_id = 'current' and artifact_path = :artifact_path and artifact_path like 'config/%'

search_configuration.title: 搜索配置
search_configuration.description: 搜索白名单配置的路径和可读文本内容。
search_configuration.sql: select artifact_path as '文件', artifact_kind as '类型', media_type as '媒体类型', text_content as '内容' from artifact where source_id = 'current' and artifact_path like 'config/%' and :query != '' and (instr(lower(artifact_path), lower(:query)) > 0 or instr(lower(coalesce(text_content, '')), lower(:query)) > 0) order by artifact_path limit 200

implementation_support.title: 实现支持矩阵
implementation_support.description: 查看当前 Base 对协议、profile、capability 与 tool pack 的支持声明。
implementation_support.sql: select support_kind as '支持类型', target_id as '目标 ID', target_version as '版本', support_status as '状态', runtime_adapter as '运行时适配器', metadata_json as '附加信息' from implementation_support order by support_kind, target_id, target_version

implementation_evidence.title: 实现证据
implementation_evidence.description: 查看 Base capability 的验证方式、实现入口和正反向测试证据。
implementation_evidence.sql: select evidence_id as '证据 ID', verification as '验证方式', implementation_json as '实现入口', positive_tests_json as '正向测试', failure_tests_json as '失败测试', details_json as '附加信息' from implementation_evidence order by evidence_id

artifact.description: 协议、实现证据与白名单配置的完整副本。

implementation_evidence.description: Base capability 的结构化实现与测试证据。
